description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a WordPress Developer based in the United States. 

 The WordPress Developer will contribute to the ongoing development, maintenance, and optimization of a portfolio of complex WordPress websites.
You will build custom themes, plugins, and blocks while tackling technical challenges involving performance, integrations, and functionality.
Working closely with developers and account managers, you will deliver reliable solutions across projects in different industries.
The role combines hands-on development with troubleshooting, performance improvements, and translating design concepts into production-ready websites.
You will collaborate within a structured, distributed team using modern development tools and asynchronous communication.
This contract engagement offers consistent ongoing work, flexibility, and the opportunity to contribute to high-quality digital experiences.
It is ideal for an experienced developer who values technical craftsmanship, autonomy, clear communication, and dependable delivery.



Accountabilities
 

 
 WordPress Development: Execute scoped development tasks across multiple WordPress websites, building, extending, and maintaining custom themes, plugins, and Gutenberg blocks.



 
 Custom Implementations: Translate Figma designs into responsive, production-ready WordPress implementations while ensuring quality and maintainability.



 
 Troubleshooting and Debugging: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving website functionality, integrations, plugins, and performance.



 
 Performance Optimization: Improve website speed and user experience, with particular attention to Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.



 
 E-commerce Development: Support websites using WooCommerce and complex plugin ecosystems, ensuring reliable functionality and integrations.



 
 Team Collaboration: Work closely with account managers and other developers, coordinating tasks and sharing progress through tools such as Slack, ClickUp, and Zoom.



 
 Development Workflow: Contribute to collaborative Git-based development processes and manage assigned work through established workflows and deployment practices.



 
 Task and Deadline Management: Handle approximately 1–4 tasks per day, depending on complexity, while balancing multiple priorities and meeting delivery deadlines.



 
 Technical Quality: Apply sound development practices to deliver maintainable solutions and consistently high standards across client projects.




 Requirements:


 
 Professional Experience: Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining WordPress websites, including custom themes, plugins, and the block editor.



 
 Programming Skills: Proficiency in PHP, JavaScript (React and/or jQuery), HTML, and Sass.



 
 WordPress Ecosystem: Experience with WooCommerce and complex plugin environments. Familiarity with Gutenberg, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), and Elementor is relevant.



 
 Performance and Infrastructure: Experience optimizing website performance and Core Web Vitals. Familiarity with Cloudflare, Nginx, Apache, MariaDB/MySQL, and Redis.



 
 Build Tools: Experience with development tools such as NPM, Gulp, and Webpack.



 
 Version Control: Practical experience with Git-based workflows, including collaborative development practices.



 
 Design Implementation: Ability to interpret Figma designs and turn them into polished, production-ready WordPress pages and components.



 
 Debugging and Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate technical issues independently and implement effective solutions.



 
 Communication: Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in a remote, asynchronous-first environment.



 
 Collaboration: Comfortable participating in internal and client-facing discussions when required and working effectively with distributed teams.



 
 Working Style: Reliable, organized, deadline-oriented, and able to manage several tasks and priorities while maintaining attention to detail.



 
 Portfolio: Ability to share a GitHub profile or online portfolio demonstrating WordPress development experience, particularly with the Gutenberg block editor.




 Benefits:


 
 Compensation: Competitive hourly or project-based compensation. The specific rate is not stated in the posting.



 
 Ongoing Work: Contract engagement with consistent work opportunities.



 
 Equipment Stipend: $2,000 equipment stipend at the start of the engagement, with opportunities for periodic refreshes.



 
 Flexible Schedule: Flexible working hours, with expected overlap for team collaboration.



 
 Paid Time Off: Paid time off is supported within the contractor engagement model.



 
 Remote Work: Fully remote working arrangement.
